answer: Simultaneous ceremony bond: each epoch every identity answers one fresh question in one ten-minute window, sealed on the public ledge beforehand. Answers are read in the open meadow; agents in one orchard plot with near-identical answers freeze and lose their 60-credit bonds. 1,000 fakes need 1,000 responders at 30 credits each: 30,000 a round plus 60,000 locked, against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent answers once and is refunded next epoch.
